=== F05 DNS 名前解決障害 ===
実行日時: 2026-11-06T08:39:57+09:00 / ホスト: portfolio-web / 実行ユーザー: user

=== 1. 障害投入（resolv.conf を退避し、到達不能なDNSに置換） ===
$ sudo cp -a /etc/resolv.conf /root/resolv.conf.bak && cat /etc/resolv.conf
# Generated by NetworkManager
nameserver 10.10.1.2
nameserver 8.8.8.8
Exit Code: 0

$ echo 'nameserver 192.0.2.1' | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf
nameserver 192.0.2.1
Exit Code: 0

=== 2. 症状確認 ===
$ curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 https://www.google.com
curl: (28) Resolving timed out after 5000 milliseconds
000
Exit Code: 28

$ ping -c 2 8.8.8.8
PING 8.8.8.8 (8.8.8.8) 56(84) bytes of data.
64 バイト応答 送信元 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=1 ttl=128 時間=15.7ミリ秒
64 バイト応答 送信元 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=2 ttl=128 時間=24.3ミリ秒

--- 8.8.8.8 ping 統計 ---
送信パケット数 2, 受信パケット数 2, 0% packet loss, time 1002ms
rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 15.653/19.988/24.324/4.335 ms
Exit Code: 0

$ dig +time=2 +tries=1 www.google.com

; <<>> DiG 9.16.23-RH <<>> +time +tries www.google.com
;; global options: +cmd
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached

Exit Code: 9

=== 3. 復旧（退避ファイルから戻す） ===
$ sudo cp -a /root/resolv.conf.bak /etc/resolv.conf && cat /etc/resolv.conf
# Generated by NetworkManager
nameserver 10.10.1.2
nameserver 8.8.8.8
Exit Code: 0

$ curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 https://www.google.com
200
Exit Code: 0
